question: What does the word "impulsive" most likely mean in the context of the passage?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Sudden and emotional. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"impulsive"** means: • Acting or done without forethought, typically as a result of a sudden strong and unreflective urge or desire. (बिना विचार के किया हुआ कार्य, अक्सर एक अचानक और अनियंत्रित प्रेरणा या इच्छा के परिणामस्वरूप) • **Example:** She made an impulsive decision to buy the dress without considering the price. • **"Correct answer"** means: • Referring to the specific answer that properly defines or fits the context of the question. (सही उत्तर) • **Example:** The correct answer to the quiz question assured him a perfect score. Therefore, the word “impulsive” in the given context means: **Sudden and emotional**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Well-planned** (अच्छी तरह योजनाबद्ध): Thought out carefully in advance. • **Example:** The event was well-planned and executed flawlessly. • **Economical** (किफायती): Using no more of something than is necessary. • **Example:** Buying in bulk is often more economical than purchasing items individually. • **Delayed and thoughtful** (विलंबित और विचारशील): Done after careful consideration, taking time to think. • **Example:** His response to the offer was delayed and thoughtful as he wanted to weigh all options. 47:Te06, The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. A secure place to park money during uncertainty.
